objective: Correct only the grouped reverse replay order for multiple omitted fact placeholders while preserving the frozen v4.2 forward normalization, eligibility predicates, diagnostics, and all accepted non-regression behavior byte-for-byte.
claim_boundary: This is an audit-reversibility correction on revealed frozen development data. Passing establishes deterministic recovery and regression safety only; it does not establish generalization and does not authorize a new holdout or any model call.

forward_normalization.operation: Delegate to the frozen v4.2 forward normalizer without modifying its output or diagnostics.
forward_normalization.required_equivalence: For every input, the v4.3 normalized output and ordered diagnostic dictionaries must equal v4.2 exactly.

reverse_replay.input: A deep-copied normalized output and its frozen ordered v4.2 diagnostic sequence.

stage_order.within_stage_order: ascending original fact_index, with original diagnostic position as a stable tie-breaker

reverse_replay.omission_invariant: Each fact_index must be a unique nonnegative integer; reinsert a deep copy of the full before value at that original index.
reverse_replay.failure_behavior: Unknown codes, duplicate omission fact_index values, invalid paths, stage/code mismatches, or before/after mismatches raise without returning a partial restoration.

v4_3_contract.allowed_source_delta: One new v4.3 compatibility adapter and its evaluator/tests/runner. Existing v4, v4.1, and frozen v4.2 files may not change.

input_shape.fact_mentions: Two valid fact mentions at original indices 0 and 1, followed by seven independently eligible empty absent-fact placeholders at original indices 2 through 8.

requirements: All frozen input and transitive source hashes match before execution.
No existing v4, v4.1, or v4.2 source or artifact changes.
Model calls, network calls, default parser calls, and canonicalizer calls are zero.
Formal outputs are created exclusively.
On external revealed raw, live raw, dev-20, all 16 existing controls, and the new tail control, v4.3 forward outputs exactly equal frozen v4.2 outputs.
Ordered diagnostic dictionaries exactly equal v4.2.
External activations remain role=0, omission=27, and long-evidence=10.
Live activations remain role=18 and both new mechanisms=0.
Dev-20 total activations remain 0.
The v4.3 forward treatment equals the frozen v4.2 treatment exactly.
All five outputs remain strict schema valid and fully source anchored.
All four multi-omission records now reverse exactly to frozen raw.
The long-evidence-only record continues to reverse exactly.
No record metadata, atom, retained fact, semantic value, evidence value, or order changes beyond the frozen v4.2 forward treatment.
The five-case live output still exactly equals frozen v4.1 and frozen v4.2 forward output; prior G1, G5, and G6 remain unchanged.
All 20 dev records and 427 atoms remain byte-equivalent with zero activations.
All 16 existing positive and negative controls retain their frozen v4.2 forward outcomes and pass reverse restoration under v4.3.
Inputs remain unmodified.
Exactly seven omission diagnostics occur at fact indices 2 through 8.
The v4.3 forward output and diagnostics exactly equal v4.2.
Frozen v4.2 reverse does not reproduce the control input.
v4.3 reverse reproduces the entire input exactly, including fact order and full values.
No other mechanism activates.
A singleton omission, role-only treatment, long-evidence-only treatment, and the combined three-stage treatment all reverse exactly.
Unknown codes, duplicate omission indices, wrong pipeline_order values, invalid indices, and output/diagnostic mismatches raise without mutating the supplied output.
An empty diagnostic sequence returns an equal deep copy.
The v4.3 runtime adapter imports only the standard library and frozen v4.2 compatibility symbols.
Static audit finds no network/model clients, parser, canonicalizer, artifact paths, gold values, case IDs, or fixture IDs in runtime code.
Focused v4.3 tests and the full regression suite pass before source freeze.
Frozen source hashes still match during formal execution.

evaluation_protocol.failure_policy: Keep v4.1 as the latest accepted compatibility layer, retain the failed v4.3 artifacts, and diagnose only from frozen data.

on_full_pass: Freeze the v4.3 source and formal report as a development-qualified candidate.
Do not claim generalization from any revealed corpus.
Only then preregister a genuinely new independent public-job holdout.
Require separate explicit authorization before transmitting any full job body.
on_any_failure: Do not modify or rerun v4.3.
Do not collect, load, or call a new holdout.
Keep v4.1 and classify the frozen failure offline before another version.

next_allowed_action: Implement only the isolated v4.3 reverse-replay adapter plus evaluator, controls, and gate runner; prove forward byte-equivalence synthetically, run focused and full tests, freeze source hashes, then execute the offline gates once.
